# Data Source: okta_behavior_new_asn

Retrieves a New ASN (Autonomous System Number) Behavior Detection Rule by `behaviorId`. The lookup fails if the ID belongs to a behavior rule of a different type (for example, `ANOMALOUS_IP` or `VELOCITY`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okta_behavior_new_asn" "example" {
  id = "<behavior_id>"
}

output "behavior_new_asn_status" {
  value = data.okta_behavior_new_asn.example.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the Behavior Detection Rule.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Timestamp when the Behavior Detection Rule was created.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp when the Behavior Detection Rule was last modified.
- `name` (String) Name of the Behavior Detection Rule.
- `settings` (Block) Settings of the Behavior Detection Rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--settings))
- `status` (String) Status of the Behavior Detection Rule (`ACTIVE` or `INACTIVE`).

<a id="nestedblock--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `max_events_used_for_evaluation` (Number) Maximum number of authentication events used to establish the user's behavior history.
- `min_events_needed_for_evaluation` (Number) Minimum number of authentication events needed before the behavior is evaluated.
